versions.name: Butte Creek Scout Ranch

features.note: A fishing pond stocked with trout each year.
Scouts pan for gold, sifting dirt and gravel as frontier prospectors did.
A working horse ranch with rides from the Butte Creek Corral; the council calls it the only Cub Scout horse ranch on the West Coast.
A western-themed frontier town with a Main Street storefront, Pony Express mail delivery, and an evening Street Show.
Rover Camp lets a Scout and a parent attend without a pack; individual Scouts are grouped together for activities.

versions.summary: Cub Scout resident camp on a Wild West horse ranch, serving Tiger, Wolf, and Bear Scouts, including the Rover individual-Scout program.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
